name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 80.0 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Potrebujem 3 lístky na zajtra ráno.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Je nás 5, vrátane 2 detí.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: Moje telefónne číslo je 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: Let trvá 9 hodín a 25 minút.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Sme 4 osoby a máme 6 kufrov.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: Izba 214 je na druhom poschodí.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Prišiel som 3. októbra a odchádzam 9. októbra.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: O koľkej otvára múzeum v nedeľu?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: Môj vlak odchádza o 18:45 z nástupišťa 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Posledný autobus odchádza o 23:30 dnes večer.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Mám rezerváciu na 20:00 pre 2 osoby.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: Otvára lekáreň pred 9. hodinou ráno?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Prehliadka začína o 14:15 a trvá 3 hodiny.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: Raňajky sa podávajú od 6:30 do 10:00.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Koľko stojí dvojlôžková izba na 3 noci?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: To stojí 45 eur vrátane dane.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Je zľava pre 2 dospelých a 1 dieťa?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: Lístok stojí 12,50 eura na osobu.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Môžem zaplatiť 78 eur kartou?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Koľko stojí kyvadlová doprava na letisko pre 2 osoby?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Denné menu stojí 15 eur vrátane nápoja.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Adresa je Calle Mayor 15, tretie poschodie.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Môj hotel je na Gran Vía 28, blízko metra.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Veľvyslanectvo je na Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Prosím, zapíšte si adresu: číslo 42, byt 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Miesto stretnutia je Plaza del Sol, brána 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Je toto cesta na Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Kde je najbližšia autobusová zastávka?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Na semaforoch odbočte vľavo a potom choďte rovno 200 metrov.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: Dá sa zo stanice do hotela dôjsť peši?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Ktorá linka ide na letisko, linka 5 alebo linka 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Prepáčte, je toto sedadlo 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Ako sa dostanem odtiaľto do starého mesta?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Múzeum je asi 15 minút pešky od námestia.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Prosím, zavolajte sanitku, niekto je v bezvedomí.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Stratil som pas a peňaženku.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Kde je najbližšia nemocnica alebo klinika?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Som alergický na arašidy; obsahuje toto jedlo nejaké?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Niekto mi ukradol tašku s 200 eurami vnútri.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Zavolajte políciu, prosím. Stala sa nehoda.
